summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc., a Nasdaq-listed clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, furnished a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report) on October 8, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the publication of a Japanese patent application covering 3-MMC-based compositions and methods for treating dyskinesia, including combinations with Palmitoylethanolamide (PEA) under a collaboration with NeuroThera Labs Inc. (TSXV: NTLX). No financial terms, securities, board recommendations, advisors, or transaction mechanics are disclosed. The filing is a routine intellectual-property update, not a special situation; watch for patent grant progress and IP-monetization or partnership signals.
